units.source_text: 嚯！

en.t: Well!

units.source_text: 这可让人吃惊。

en.t: That really is surprising.

units.source_text: 老师终于下定决心写东西了。

en.t: So the teacher has finally made up his mind to write something.

units.source_text: 还是要靠真实体验呐。

en.t: I suppose it all comes down to real experience after all.

units.source_text: 听说不给皮肤一点刺激，连蚯蚓也长不大。

en.t: They say even an earthworm will not grow unless its skin gets a little stimulation.

units.source_text: ……谢谢，实际上连标题都想好了……

en.t: ... Thank you; actually, I have even thought of the title already...

units.source_text: 嘿，什么样的标题……

en.t: Oh? What kind of title...

units.source_text: “沙丘的恶魔”，或者是“蚂蚁地狱的恐怖”……

en.t: The Demon of the Dunes, or perhaps The Terror of the Ant Lion Pit...

units.source_text: 这可是相当有猎奇趣味的题材呀。

en.t: That is quite a sensationally curious subject, you know.

units.source_text: 可会不会给人过多不正经的印象呢？

en.t: But might it not give people too much of an unserious impression?

units.source_text: ……是吗？

en.t: ... Do you think so?

units.source_text: ……不管那么强烈的体验，如果只描写事件的表面，那实在太没意思了。

en.t: ... No matter how intense the experience was, it would be terribly dull if you only described the surface of the incident.

units.source_text: 必须写一下悲剧的主人公，就是当地人，这才能显示出一些解决的方向，

en.t: You have to write about the tragic protagonists, the local people; only then can you show some direction toward a solution,

units.source_text: 否则，好容易得来的体验可就得哭喽……

en.t: otherwise that hard-won experience will go to waste and weep for itself...

units.source_text: 妈的……

en.t: Damn it...

units.source_text: 什么？

en.t: What?

units.source_text: ……是哪里在清扫下水道吗？

en.t: ... Are they cleaning a sewer somewhere?

units.source_text: 还是走廊里洒的消毒药水与老师嘴里出来的大蒜分解物，起了什么化学反应吧……

en.t: Or maybe the disinfectant sprinkled in the corridor is having some chemical reaction with the garlic breakdown products coming from your mouth, teacher...

units.source_text: 说什么？

en.t: What did you say?

units.source_text: ……不，请别担心，刚刚写完了一些，我这号人反正也成不了作家……

en.t: ... No, please do not worry. I have just finished writing a little, but someone like me will never become a writer anyway...

units.source_text: 这又是与身份不配的谦逊，我觉得没有必要把作家看得太高。

en.t: That is another humility unsuited to your position; I do not think there is any need to put writers on such a pedestal.

units.source_text: 能写，就是作家了嘛……

en.t: If you can write, then you are a writer...

units.source_text: 快，怎么样，天经地义，教师这种人动不动就想乱写……

en.t: Come now, what do you think? It is only natural; teachers are the sort who always want to scribble nonsense...

units.source_text: 这就是职业习惯，那是比较接近作家的关系嘛……

en.t: It is an occupational habit, since the profession is fairly close to being a writer...

units.source_text: 就是你说过的“创造性教育”那玩意儿吗？

en.t: Is that the thing you called creative education?

units.source_text: 自己甚至连一个粉笔盒都没做过……

en.t: Though you yourself have never even made a chalk box...

units.source_text: 所谓粉笔盒，可是非同寻常呐。

en.t: A so-called chalk box is no ordinary thing, you know.

units.source_text: 仅就它能提醒自己是个什么角色这一点来看，难道它不是个优秀的创造吗？

en.t: Just in the fact that it reminds you what role you are playing, is it not an excellent creation?

units.source_text: ……靠了它，体尝了新的苦痛，硬是掌握了新的感觉……

en.t: ... Thanks to it, I tasted a new pain and forcibly acquired a new sensation...

units.source_text: 而且有希望。

en.t: And there is hope.

units.source_text: 这份希望是真是假，可是不负责任喽……

en.t: Whether that hope is real or false is, admittedly, something I cannot answer for...

units.source_text: 今后的前途只有相信冥冥中的力量了。

en.t: As for the future from here on, I can only trust in some unseen power.

units.source_text: 好啦，安心宽慰就到此结束，

en.t: All right, that is the end of comforting reassurance,

units.source_text: 好歹教师不能容忍这样的可恶品德……

en.t: after all, a teacher cannot tolerate such a hateful moral trait...

units.source_text: 可恶品德？

en.t: A hateful moral trait?

units.source_text: ……是作家呀。

en.t: ... Being a writer, I mean.

units.source_text: 想成为作家，不过是一种利己主义的考虑，

en.t: Wanting to become a writer is nothing more than a selfish calculation,

units.source_text: 当个使唤木偶的人，想把自己同木偶区别开来。

en.t: the desire of someone who manipulates puppets to distinguish himself from the puppets.

units.source_text: 从本质上讲，它和女人的化妆毫无二致……

en.t: In essence, it is no different at all from a woman's makeup...

units.source_text: 可真严厉啊。

en.t: That is really harsh.

units.source_text: 可是，老师要是把“作家”理解为这种意思，那么，作家和所写的东西也许该有某种程度的区别吧……

en.t: But if you understand writer in that sense, teacher, then perhaps there ought to be some degree of distinction between the writer and what is written...

units.source_text: 是吗？

en.t: Is that so?

units.source_text: 所以我想当一回作家呀。

en.t: That is why I want to try being a writer once.

units.source_text: 成不了作家，当然也就没有非得要写的必要喽！

en.t: If I cannot become a writer, then of course there is no absolute need for me to write!
